responsibility: Implements the interprocedural HSA offloading pass that identifies functions marked for HSA execution, creates virtual callgraph clones for GPU kernels and callable GPU functions, and rewires clone-to-clone call edges so the GPU side of the callgraph is self-contained. It also owns the LTO summary streaming for HSA function metadata via hsa_summaries, including kernel/function kind, GPU-implementation status, and clone binding, and registers the IPA pass hook that runs only when HSA code generation is requested.
